$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs in CI (manager/rules/SEO.md). actorId pins the actor the first deploy created, so CI updates it by ID and a rename of name in actor.json keeps the same actor.
seoTitle: Job Search API for 18 Job Boards and ATS Sites
seoDescription: Search Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby, Hiring Cafe, YC, Wellfound and 11 more job boards in one run. Newest jobs first, each listed once, live data.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Provisional 4 GB (one CPU core: the 18 boards are read at once in one process, 128 s of CPU and 0.75 GB peak on a laptop for data analyst in London, 2026-11-13); to be measured on Apify at 2 and 4 GB before publishing. timeoutSecs 900: secondsPerBoard (240) caps the search, the rest is details and saving.

pricing.$comment: 2026-11-13, PROPOSED, apply false until the unpriced cost of a run is measured on Apify. Rule: rules/SEO.md section 16. Closest rival: agentx/all-jobs-scraper (42 platforms, 204 u30): $0.0035 a job + $0.01 start on FREE; job is 14% under it. Others with 80+ u30: fantastic-jobs API $0.012 + $0.01, feed $0.0025 + $0.10, jobo $0.004, hirebase $0.005, factpipe $0.005, yugenox $0.002, memo23 $0.004 + $0.03, bovi $0.0015, jtpalms $0.003. board: one per board a search reads, charged as the run starts (ats_jobs.many.charge_boards), because a search scans every board whatever it saves; flat on every plan like start fees. No apify-actor-start: the board fee is the start fee. Gentle ladder (owner, 2026-10-29) on job and job-details.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, places, work type, job type, pay, posting date, the board it came from and its links. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, pay as numbers with its currency, and the address.

board.eventDescription: Charged once for each job board a search reads, when the run starts: 18 when every board is searched. It pays for reading every company on that board, whatever the search saves. Checking job links charges none.
